trap.label: Search in another browser tab
trap.warn_text: Switching tabs isn't allowed in this assessment. One event has been recorded.
trap.fail_text: A second tab switch breaks the assessment rules, so this attempt is void.
trap.explain: 切屏限制是本场游戏规则，真实在线测评以当次通知为准。未经允许的搜索不能替代独立完成。

fgf_t1.text: A task took 80 seconds before a change and 60 seconds after it. What was the percentage reduction?
fgf_t1.explain: 减少20秒，以原来的80秒为分母，20/80=25%。33.3%用的是新值60作分母，表示另一个比较口径。

fgf_t2.text: A team note says: "All critical fixes need review. Some reviewed changes are optional." Which conclusion must follow?

options.text: Every reviewed change is critical.
Some critical fixes are optional.
Every critical fix must be reviewed.
Optional changes never need to be reviewed.

fgf_t2.explain: 第一句直接说明所有关键修复需要评审。第二句没有说明关键修复与可选改动的交集，不能反推所有已评审改动都是关键修复。

options.text: A B C
B A C
A C B
C A B

fgf_t3.explain: 同步脚本先输出A、C，已解决Promise的回调随后在微任务检查点输出B。

fgf_t4.text: Release note: "The pilot covers desktop users only. Mobile support is planned, but no date is confirmed." Which statement does the note support?

options.text: The pilot includes every device.
Mobile support has a fixed release date.
Desktop pilot results prove mobile readiness.
Mobile support has no confirmed date yet.

fgf_t4.explain: 文本只确认桌面试点和移动支持尚无明确日期。不能把计划当作已确认交付，也不能把桌面验证推广成移动可用。

fgf_t5.text: A user clicks Save, the request times out, and the server may have completed it. What is the safest next step?

options.text: Resend the same request again right away.
Check the status, then retry with an idempotency key.
Assume the timeout means nothing was saved and show an error.
Disable the Save button until the next page reload.

fgf_t5.explain: 超时只说明客户端没有等到响应，不能证明服务端没有完成。应先查询状态，或者带上幂等键重试，这样同一个操作不会被创建成两份；原样重发可能造成重复，禁用保存按钮也解决不了状态不明。

fgf_t6.text: A pilot has 30 failures in 1,000 attempts. The old version has 80 in 4,000. Which statement is accurate?

options.text: The pilot's failure rate is 1 percentage point higher.
The pilot is better because 30 is fewer than 80.
Both versions fail at the same rate, about 2 percent.
The pilot's failure rate is 1 percent lower than before.

fgf_t6.explain: 试点失败率是 30/1000=3%，旧版是 80/4000=2%，高出 1 个百分点。失败次数不能跨不同的流量直接比较；这个差异本身也不能单独说明原因。

fgf_t7.text: A job processes 240 rows in 4 minutes at a constant rate. How many rows does it process in 7 minutes?
fgf_t7.explain: 每分钟60行，7分钟为420行。题目明确固定速率，不需额外假定并发或机器变化。

fgf_t8.text: Five requests took 120, 130, 140, 150 and 960 ms. Which statement is accurate?

options.text: The mean is 140 ms, since most requests finished close to that time.
The median is 300 ms, since the slow request has to be counted.
The median is 135 ms, the average of the four fast requests.
The median is 140 ms; a slow request pulls the mean up to 300 ms.

fgf_t8.explain: 五个值排序后取中间的第3个，中位数是140 ms；平均数是(120+130+140+150+960)/5=1500/5=300 ms。一个960 ms的慢请求把平均数拉到远高于其余请求，所以中位数更接近典型请求的体验。平均数仍有用，它反映总耗时；看延迟分布时通常还要配合高分位数一起看。

fgf_t9.text: A page sends a cross-origin fetch with a JSON body and an Authorization header. DevTools shows a failed OPTIONS request and no POST. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: The server's answer to the preflight check didn't allow the request.
The server rejected the JSON, so the browser retried with OPTIONS.
The POST response lacked CORS headers, so the browser discarded it.
Browsers can't send JSON across origins, so the API needs form data.

fgf_t9.explain: 跨域请求带application/json或Authorization这类非简单请求头，浏览器会先发一个OPTIONS预检请求，问服务器是否允许这个来源、方法和请求头。预检没通过，浏览器就不会发出真正的POST，所以DevTools里只有失败的OPTIONS。服务器需要对OPTIONS返回2xx，并带上Access-Control-Allow-Origin、Allow-Methods、Allow-Headers。顺序是先预检、后正式请求，不是被拒后重试；POST根本没发出，也就谈不上它的响应缺头；浏览器可以跨域发JSON，只要服务端允许。
